sections.title: Gear Recipe
sections.text: name is nonblank; module,faceWidth are positive length-expression strings and teeth is a positive integer. pressureAngle defaults 20 deg. system is metric (ha=1.0,hf=1.25) or short (ha=0.8,hf=1.0); explicit addendumCoefficient/dedendumCoefficient override. profileShift is a finite number x. rootTreatment is straight|trochoidal (default trochoidal, reporting a root fillet radius 0.38*module). toothThicknessReduction and backlashAllocation are nonnegative lengths subtracted from the pitch tooth thickness. flankTolerance (default 0.001 mm) controls involute sampling density. Diameters: pitch d=module*teeth, base db=d*cos(pressureAngle), addendum da=module*(teeth+2*ha+2x), root df=module*(teeth-2*hf+2x). The recipe creates a root disc (driving root radius), a tooth sketch with two sampled involute flank polylines (chordal line segments, never fitted splines) plus a tip arc, a root arc and two radial transitions, then extrudes the tooth joined and circular-patterns it teeth times about axis (default Z). Optional bore/hub/key add a native hole, boss and keyway. plane defaults XY and must be native; frame is a datum.frame name or descriptor.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result = {feature:Ref,bodies:Ref[],healthState:integer,message:string,blank:{...},tooth:{...},pattern:{...},bore?:{...},hub?:{...},key?:{...},helpers:[Ref,...],recipe:gear,atomic:false,diameters:{pitch,base,addendum,root},diameterExpressions:{...},toothCount:integer,pressureAngle:string,rootTreatment:string,rootFilletRadius:string,undercut:{undercut,minimumTeeth},toothThickness:number,approximationError:number,dependencies:string,regeneration:recipeRegeneration}. Ref has token:string|null,kind:string,name:string|null. Diameter values are cm floats; diameterExpressions are the native-equivalent strings. Envelope records internal creations. Recipe is not atomic; involute flanks are sampled chordal segments and regenerate only by re-running the recipe.

examples.label: Standard 20-tooth gear
examples.requires: Native component; Gear and helper names unused.
examples.output: result.diameters gives d=4.0 cm, db=d*cos(20deg), da=m*(z+2); result.undercut flags low tooth counts; result.pattern.feature is the final gear.

verified: d=mz, db=d*cos(alpha), da=m(z+2) for the standard system
Involute chordal-segment flanks, driving tip/root radii and circular pattern

sections.title: Pair Check
sections.text: gear1 and gear2 are gear descriptors {module,teeth,pressureAngle?,system?,profileShift?,backlashAllocation?,toothThicknessReduction?} that must share one module. external defaults true; false models internal gearing with a signed ratio. centerDistance (optional) computes the operating working pressure angle from the base diameters; phase is a finite numeric angle in radians. schemaVersion must be 1. Read-only: no document mutation and no native feature is created.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result = {schemaVersion:1,success:boolean,status:pass|fail,operation:gear.pair-check,ratio:number,sign:number,centerDistance:number,nominalCenterDistance:number,external:boolean,phase:number,workingAngle:number,nominalPressureAngle:number,backlash:number,undercut:{gear1,gear2},teeth:[z1,z2],diameters:{gear1,gear2},units,frame,associativity,warnings,method,limitations,provenance}. Lengths are cm and angles radians. status is fail when either gear undercuts or the working angle is nonpositive. Backlash is the sum of the two declared per-gear allocations and thickness reductions, not an unconditional split of one value.

examples.label: External 20/40 pair
examples.requires: Open design document (read-only); gears share module 2 mm.
examples.output: result.ratio is 2.0, sign 1, centerDistance m*(20+40)/2; result.backlash sums declared allocations.

verified: Ratio/sign, center distance and working angle from the involute model
Backlash as the sum of per-gear allocations and undercut detection
